
```{r}

yr1=min(shapeused[shapeused$country==country,]$year)
yr2=max(shapeused[shapeused$country==country,]$year)


c1=shapeused[shapeused$country==country& shapeused$year==yr1,]$n_geo_cluster
c2=shapeused[shapeused$country==country& shapeused$year==yr2,]$n_geo_cluster
c11=shapeused[shapeused$country==country& shapeused$year==yr1,]$n_cluster
c22=shapeused[shapeused$country==country& shapeused$year==yr2,]$n_cluster



ad11=shapeused[shapeused$country==country& shapeused$year==yr1,]$n_admin1
ad12=shapeused[shapeused$country==country& shapeused$year==yr1,]$n_admin2
indicatorlist=infolist$ID
```

## Overview 

This report presents extra infomation on:

- **Clsuter**  
- **API check**  
- **Variance fix**  


## Clsuter information

DHS surveys included `r c1 ` clusters in `r yr1` and `r c2 ` clusters in `r yr2` from geo data, after removing clusters with no GPS information, there are  `r c11 ` clusters in `r yr2` and `r c22 ` clusters in `r yr1`. The maps show cluster locations for `r yr1` and `r yr2`




 
```{r, echo = FALSE, out.width = "80%", fig.cap = "cluster locations and shapefiles (Baseline) "}
check_dir <-file.path(source_path, "Gates-results/check")
knitr::include_graphics(file.path(check_dir,country, yr1,paste0(country,"_",yr1,".png")))
```


```{r, echo = FALSE, out.width = "80%", fig.cap = "cluster locations and shapefiles (Latest)"}
check_dir <-file.path(source_path, "Gates-results/check")
knitr::include_graphics(file.path(check_dir,country, yr2,paste0(country,"_",yr2,".png")))
```

```{r }

tab=read.csv(file.path(source_path,"Gates-results/estimates", country, "National_clusters.csv"))
pretty_names <- gsub("\\.", " ", names(tab)) 
tab <- tab %>%
   dplyr::left_join(
    infolist %>%  dplyr::select(Indicator = Description, Group, ID),
    by = "Indicator"
  ) %>%
  dplyr:: arrange(Group, ID) %>%  # change Indicator to another column if needed
 dplyr:: select(-ID)
# order groups like your sidebar and sort rows
group_order <- c("Child Health", "Maternal Health", "Outcomes",  "Social determinants")
tab2 <- tab %>%
  mutate(group = factor(Group, levels = group_order)) %>%
  arrange(group, Indicator)
tab2$Indicator[4]="Percentage of children 12-23 months who had received MCV 1"
# row counts per group for pack_rows()
idx <- table(tab2$group)


# pretty column names (remove dots)
# pretty_names <- c("Indicator", "DHS 2013", "DHS 2018")


pretty_names <- c("Indicator", paste0("DHS ", yr1), paste0("DHS ", yr2))

kable(tab2[1:3], #%>% dplyr::select(Indicator, DHS.2013, DHS.2018),
      col.names = pretty_names,
      align = c("l", "r", "r"),
      booktabs = TRUE, caption = "Number of clusters")%>%  # ) 
kable_styling(latex_options = "hold_position",
                position = "center", 
              
              full_width = FALSE, 
              stripe_color = "gray!10") %>%
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE) %>%
  add_header_above(c(" " = 1, "Survey Year" = 2)) %>%
  pack_rows(index = idx)   # <— adds “Child Health”, “Characteristics”, “Maternal Health” sections




```

## Variance fix

```{r}

image_dir1 <- normalizePath(file.path(source_path, "Gates-results/check", params$country,yr1),
                           winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)

files1 <- sort(list.files(path = image_dir1,
                         pattern = "-check-var\\.fix\\.png$",
                         full.names = TRUE,
                         recursive = FALSE))

files2 <- sort(list.files(path = image_dir1,
                         pattern = "-check-var-fh\\.fix\\.png$",
                         full.names = TRUE,
                         recursive = FALSE))

image_dir2 <- normalizePath(file.path(source_path, "Gates-results/check", params$country,yr2),
                           winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)


files3<- sort(list.files(path = image_dir2,
                         pattern = "-check-var\\.fix\\.png$",
                         full.names = TRUE,
                         recursive = FALSE))

files4 <- sort(list.files(path = image_dir2,
                         pattern = "-check-var-fh\\.fix\\.png$",
                         full.names = TRUE,
                         recursive = FALSE))



```



```{r, echo=FALSE, results='asis' , out.width='\\ linewidth'}
latex_img <- function(p, width="\\linewidth") {
  if (length(p) == 0 || is.na(p) || !nzchar(p) || !file.exists(p)) {
    cat(sprintf("\\textit{(missing file) %s}\\\\\n\n", ifelse(length(p), p, "")))
    return(invisible())
  }
  cat(sprintf("\\begin{center}\\includegraphics[width=%s]{%s}\\end{center}\n\n",
              width, p))
}



indicatorlists=indicatorlist
for (i in seq_along(indicatorlists)) {
  cat("\\newpage\n\n")

id  <- indicatorlists[i]
#def <- infolist$Full_definition[infolist$ID == id]
short <- infolist$Description[infolist$ID == id]
cat(sprintf("## %s\n\n", short))
#cat(sprintf("`%s`: %s\n\n", id, def))
  cat(infolist[infolist$ID == indicatorlists[i], ]$Description, "\n\n", sep = "")

    cat("\\textbf{scatter plot for direct estimates (Baseline)}\n\n")
  if (i <= length(files1))   latex_img(files1[i], ".9\\linewidth")
  
     cat("\\textbf{scatter plot for Fay–Herriot (Baseline)}\n\n")
  if (i <= length(files2))   latex_img(files2[i], ".9\\linewidth")
    
  
   cat("\\newpage\n\n")

    cat("\\textbf{scatter plot for direct estimates  (Latest)}\n\n")
  if (i <= length(files3))   latex_img(files3[i], ".9\\linewidth")
  
     cat("\\textbf{scatter plot for Fay–Herriot  (Latest)}\n\n")
  if (i <= length(files4))   latex_img(files4[i], ".9\\linewidth")
    
}
```
